_sobre: Fonte única da marca Ninho Alto Coffee. Toda peça (rótulos, site, manual, vídeos, 3D) lê daqui. Mudou aqui, roda tools/manual_ninho.py e tools/rotulo_ninho.py.
aviso_conceito: Concept project — fictional brand by Precioso Productions
promessa: Grown above 1,100 m. Roasted the week you order.
conceito: Direct-to-consumer specialty coffee from the Mantiqueira highlands of Minas Gerais, Brazil. Three lots, each from a named slope. Roasted on demand on Mondays, shipped within 72 hours, 15% off on subscription.
publico: US coffee drinkers who buy whole bean online, care about origin data and brew at home (pour-over, espresso).

voz.resumo: Direct and technical without being snobbish. Every sentence carries one concrete fact: an altitude, a process, a number of hours.
faca: Picked at 1,400 m. Fermented 72 hours without oxygen. Tastes like red berries and panela.
Roasted Monday, at your door by Thursday.
Use 18 g of coffee for 300 g of water. Start at 93 °C.
evite: The finest beans on Earth, handpicked with love.
Exclamation marks, emoji, and superlatives without a number.

neutras.uso: Page background. The ground of every screen.
Labels and packaging only. Never a page background.
Behind product renders; the tone of the stone slab.

cores.regra: Color lives on the packaging. Interfaces stay neutral; a lot color appears only as the label band, the product dot and that lot's contour lines.

sans.uso: Everything: headlines, body, buttons. 600 only in the wordmark.

mono.uso: Lot sheets, prices, altitudes, small uppercase labels. Always tabular figures.

escala.exemplo: Three lots from one mountain range.
Dark cocoa, molasses, almond. Natural, 1,250 m.

espaco.regra: Square corners everywhere (labels are cut paper). Hairlines instead of shadows.

logo.respiro: Clear space on every side equals the cap height of the wordmark (H).
nao: Do not set it in another typeface or weight.
Do not tighten the letter spacing.
Do not add the old sun-and-mountain symbol or any mascot.
Do not place it over a busy part of a photo.
Do not use it in lowercase.
Do not outline, shadow or gradient it.

regras: Light
One soft window light from camera left, about 45°. Shadows fall right and stay open.
Surface
Grey stone slab (Slab tone). No wood, no burlap, no linen.
Props
Beans, one ceramic cup, a pour-over cone. Never more than two at once.
Lens
50 mm equivalent, eye level or 30° above. No fisheye, no dutch angle.
Crop
Products 4:5. Hero 16:9 on desktop, 4:3 on phones. Vertical video 9:16.
Source
Every image is a Blender render from blender/ninho_produto.py. No stock photos.
Speed
Slow and physical. Camera moves take 5–8 s; nothing snaps.
Camera
Dolly in, slow orbit up to 30°, or a locked shot. No zoom punches, no whip pans.
Physics
Beans fall, bounce and settle at real-world speed under real gravity. No slow-motion tricks.
Easing
Ease-in-out (cubic) on every camera move; linear only for falling objects.
Length
Reels and ads 8–15 s and they loop: the last frame matches the first.
Type
Text cuts in and out, never flies. One line at a time, Body or Lead size, Label for data.
Sound
Room tone and the sound of beans. No stock music swells.
